candidates.title: City station readings (hourly), NO2 and PM2.5
candidates.why_relevant: Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 from the city's own stations, covering 2023-01-01 onward, so it spans the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Grain and pollutants match N1.
candidates.found_via: search 'hourly air quality station readings NO2 PM2.5'; get_catalog_entry airq.station_readings; read_wiki_page station_network
suspected_issues: Station VR-03 (Via Roma) switched off 2024-06-30 per wiki station_network, yet catalog still lists the network as active; no VR-03 readings after that date
Timestamps are UTC (ts_utc); must align with local-time traffic counts and weather
No station coordinates or location field in the catalog entry; station-to-traffic and station-to-weather join not documented
Access by request to Environment Monitoring Unit (warehouse SQL); receipt not confirmed
Catalog coverage does not reach 2004-2005; prototype window needs a public source

candidates.title: Road traffic counts (hourly)
candidates.why_relevant: Hourly vehicle counts from road counters near the monitoring stations, with coverage from 2021-01-01; the only traffic dataset found in the catalog for N2.
candidates.found_via: search 'traffic counts hourly loop detectors'; get_catalog_entry traffic.hourly_counts; read_wiki_page counter_replacement_2024
suspected_issues: Road counters replaced 2024-03-18: counts per direction before, both directions combined after; wiki says do not compare without adjustment and the catalog has no note of this
Timestamps are local time (ts_local), not UTC as in air-quality data
No documented join key between counter_id and N1 station codes; distance from stations not stated
Sensor outage/gap rates not documented
Access by request to Mobility Office

candidates.title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district)
candidates.why_relevant: Daily respiratory visit counts by district, documented as containing no patient identifiers. It is the only clinic dataset the Data Protection wiki allows for this analysis.
candidates.found_via: search 'respiratory clinic visits daily count district'; get_catalog_entry clinic.resp_visits_daily; read_wiki_page clinic_data_policy
suspected_issues: Catalog coverage starts 2022-01-01; covers production window 2024-2025
Small-cell suppression rule not documented
District codes: no published geography link documented
Late capture of recent days not documented
Clinical respiratory definition (ICD range) not documented
Access by request to Clinical Analytics

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Hourly reanalysis weather for any coordinates; approved for prototyping and production. Serves the temperature part of N3 for both windows.
suspected_issues: Register default_query coordinates (45.4642, 9.1900) are Milan, not the client location; Italian coordinates must be set and justified in decisions.md (no source names the client city)
Configured hourly variables are temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation only; relative humidity is NOT configured, so N3 humidity is a coverage gap
Reanalysis grid cell is coarser than a city station
Default timezone is UTC; must align with air-quality ts_utc and local-time traffic

candidates.title: AtmosData Pro station-grade weather feed (fictional vendor)
candidates.why_relevant: Station-grade weather feed that could supply production-window temperature and humidity; the only register source named for station-grade production weather.
suspected_issues: BLOCKED: agreement_status expired; contract AD-2021-114 ran 2022-01-01 to 2025-12-31; renewal waiting on Procurement, no signed renewal on file
API key revoked 2026-01-01
approved_purposes empty; not usable for any window
Do not use for production weather unless a signed renewal is recorded

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
candidates.why_relevant: Public-holiday calendar, usable as a covariate for daily clinic counts (counts drop on holidays). Set country to IT for 2024 and 2025.
suspected_issues: Country parameter must be set to IT; register param_notes give example codes only
Holidays are a covariate only; they do not supply clinic counts
